A protest by Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena against Sonia Gandhi's memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love has triggered a political controversy. During the protest, Shaina NC inadvertently tore a paper featuring an image of Bal Thackeray. While she denied tearing Bal Thackeray's photograph and accused the Opposition of creating a false narrative, the incident drew sharp reactions from Congress and Shiv Sena (UBT). Here's what happened.
